summary: A smoky, modern alternative to black. This rich, velvety matte plum pencil glides along the lash line to deliver deep, sultry definition.
technical_overview: Offered at $17.0 for 1.2g, this KoColor Fashion EYELINER is expertly formulated with Manganese Violet, Iron Oxides, Mica, Hydrogenated Oil. Delivering a high-fidelity Deep Plum (Matte) color profile (`#4B0082`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
